license_required.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

issuing_authority.quote: The Board of Licensure in Medicine, the Board of Osteopathic Licensure, the Board of Licensure of Podiatric Medicine and the Board of Chiropractic Licensure shall enforce the provisions of this section

name.quote: The Board of Licensure in Medicine, the Board of Osteopathic Licensure, the Board of Licensure of Podiatric Medicine and the Board of Chiropractic Licensure shall enforce the provisions of this section

type.quote: The power to license and to set standards of practice for physicians and surgeons practicing medicine in Maine

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Professional and Financial Regulation
umbrella_agency.quote: The Commissioner of Professional and Financial Regulation acts as a liaison between the board and the Governor.

degree_required.value: Graduate from a medical school designated as accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, or unaccredited with ECFMG evaluation
degree_required.quote: Graduate from a medical school designated as accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education

accrediting_body.quote: Graduate from a medical school designated as accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education

required.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program

duration.value: 36 months (for graduates on or after July 1, 2004); 24 months (for graduates January 1, 1970 to July 1, 2004); 12 months (for graduates before January 1, 1970)
duration.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program

kind.quote: satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program accredited by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education

exams.name: Uniform examination of the Federation of State Medical Boards (USMLE)
exams.notes: Each applicant must achieve a passing score on each component
exams.quote: Each applicant must achieve a passing score on each component of the uniform examination of the Federation of State Medical Boards or other examinations designated by the board as the qualifying examination or examinations for licensure.

exams.name: State of Maine examination
exams.notes: In addition to the FSMB uniform examination
exams.quote: Each applicant must additionally achieve a passing score on a State of Maine examination administered by the board.

interval_years.quote: the board shall provide to every physician whose application is approved and accepted a proof of license renewal that is valid for no longer than 2 years

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The board may charge a license renewal application fee of not more than $500 to all applicants for license renewal.

required.quote: Every licensee seeking renewal of a license with the intent of conducting active medical practice in this State shall submit evidence, satisfactory to the board, of successful completion of a course of continuing medical education within the preceding 24 months

period_years.quote: successful completion of a course of continuing medical education within the preceding 24 months, as prescribed by rule

value: 3 hours on prescription of opioid medication every 2 years (as condition of prescribing opioid medication)
topical_requirements.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

available.quote: The board may, at its discretion, grant licensure without written examination to a physician in good standing who otherwise meets the requirements of section 3271

requirements.value: Examined and certified by the National Board of Medical Examiners; or licensed by another state with equivalent examination; or graduate of nationally accredited medical school examined by Medical Council of Canada or equivalent board
requirements.quote: Examined and certified by the National Board of Medical Examiners; Examined and licensed by a board of another state, if the examination passed by the applicant is determined by the board to be equivalent to its own examination

approximate.matched_normalized: examined and licensed by a board of another state if the examination passed by the applicant is determined by the board to be equivalent to its own examination

exists.quote: The power to license and to set standards of practice for physicians and surgeons practicing medicine in Maine

national_certification.quote: Examined and certified by the National Board of Medical Examiners

national_association.value: Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education
national_association.quote: satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program accredited by the Accreditation Council on Graduate Medical Education

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

credential_type.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

is_mandatory.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

title_protection.quote: Whoever, not being duly licensed by the board, practices medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery, or purports to practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery in a way cited in this section, or who uses the title "Doctor" or the letters "Dr." or the letters "M.D." in connection with that individual's name, contrary to this section, commits a Class E crime.

scope_protection.quote: Unless licensed by the board, an individual may not practice medicine or surgery or a branch of medicine or surgery

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license or in connection with services rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license under this chapter or in connection with service rendered within the scope of the license issued

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances endangering health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that endangers health or safety of patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an unlicensed individual who claims to be legally licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting the practice of medicine by an individual who is not licensed under this chapter and who claims to be legally licensed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed. A licensee is considered incompetent in the practice if the licensee has: (1) Engaged in conduct that evidences a lack of ability or fitness to discharge the duty owed by the licensee to a client or patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a standard of professional behavior or engaging in disruptive behavior
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct. A licensee is considered to have engaged in unprofessional conduct if the licensee violates a standard of professional behavior, including engaging in disruptive behavior

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, false statement, or related to the practice, or for which incarceration of one year or more may be imposed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime that involves dishonesty or false statement or relates directly to the practice for which the licensee is licensed, or conviction of a crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing narcotic, hypnotic, or controlled substances for other than accepted therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing narcotic or hypnotic or other drugs listed as controlled substances by the Drug Enforcement Administration for other than accepted therapeutic purposes

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report an impaired physician for addiction to alcohol, drugs, or mental illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to report to the secretary of the board a physician licensed under this chapter for addiction to alcohol or drugs or for mental illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, or surrender of license in another state or territory for conduct that would constitute grounds for discipline in Maine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation, suspension or restriction of a license to practice medicine or other disciplinary action; denial of an application for a license; or surrender of a license to practice medicine following the institution of disciplinary action by another state or a territory

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any activity requiring a license beyond the scope of acts authorized by the license held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any activity requiring a license under the governing law of the board that is beyond the scope of acts authorized by the license held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to act in a capacity requiring a license after expiration, suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing to act in a capacity requiring a license under the governing law of the board after expiration, suspension or revocation of that license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with an order or consent agreement of the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Noncompliance with an order or consent agreement of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce upon request documents concerning a pending complaint or investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to produce upon request of the board any documents in the licensee's possession or under the licensee's control concerning a pending complaint or proceeding or any matter under investigation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely respond to a complaint notification sent by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to timely respond to a complaint notification sent by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of section 3300-G (prohibition on providing conversion therapy to minors)

definition_quote.value: diagnosing, relieving in any degree or curing, or professing or attempting to diagnose, relieve or cure a human disease, ailment, defect or complaint, whether physical or mental, or of physical and mental origin, by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever
definition_quote.quote: diagnosing, relieving in any degree or curing, or professing or attempting to diagnose, relieve or cure a human disease, ailment, defect or complaint, whether physical or mental, or of physical and mental origin, by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever

methods_authorized.quote: by diagnosing, relieving in any degree or curing, or professing or attempting to diagnose, relieve or cure a human disease, ailment, defect or complaint, whether physical or mental, or of physical and mental origin, by attendance or by advice, or by prescribing or furnishing a drug, medicine, appliance, manipulation, method or a therapeutic agent whatsoever

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs including controlled substances; subject to opioid prescribing limits of 100 MME/day for chronic pain patients and 7-day supply for acute pain patients, with exceptions for cancer, palliative care, end-of-life, hospice, and MAT
drug_authority.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

license_status_types.quote: The board may issue a license limited to the practice of administrative medicine, or any other special license, as defined by routine technical rule of the board

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates from unaccredited schools must be evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and receive a permanent certificate, or pass the Visa Qualifying Examination. Must complete at least 36 months of accredited postgraduate training. Waiver available for foreign graduates with 3+ years clinical experience licensed in another state.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: Graduate from an unaccredited medical school, be evaluated by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates and receive a permanent certificate from the Educational Commission for Foreign Graduates

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: Each applicant who has graduated from an accredited medical school on or after July 1, 2004 or an unaccredited medical school must have satisfactorily completed at least 36 months in a graduate educational program

pain_management_education_required.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: 100 MME/day maximum; 7-day supply limit for acute pain; 30-day supply limit for chronic pain within a 30-day period; exceptions for cancer pain, palliative care, end-of-life/hospice care, MAT, and inpatient/surgical settings
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter and whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Out-of-state physicians may provide consultative telehealth services to Maine patients if registered with the board, fully licensed without restriction in their home state, not meeting patients in person in Maine, and providing only consultative services requested by a Maine-licensed provider who retains ultimate authority
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A physician not licensed to practice medicine in this State may provide consultative services through interstate telehealth to a patient located in this State if the physician is registered in accordance with subsection 3.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: The board may register a physician to practice medicine in this State through interstate telehealth if the following conditions are met

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The board shall request a background check for an individual licensed under this chapter who applies for an expedited license under section 18506.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician assistant with less than 4,000 hours of clinical practice documented to the board shall work in accordance with a collaborative agreement with an active physician that describes the physician assistant's scope of practice

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe and dispense prescription and legend drugs including schedule II-V controlled substances, subject to limitations on dispensing (only when pharmacy not available, in best interests of patient, or emergency exists)
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: a physician assistant who dispenses a prescription or legend drug: A. Shall comply with all relevant federal and state laws and federal regulations and state rules; and B. May dispense the prescription or legend drug only when: (1) A pharmacy service is not reasonably available; (2) Dispensing the drug is in the best interests of the patient; or (3) An emergency exists.

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: Failure to report to the secretary of the board a physician licensed under this chapter for addiction to alcohol or drugs or for mental illness in accordance with Title 24, section 2505, except when the impaired physician is or has been a patient of the licensee

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the board may compel a physician to submit to a mental or physical examination by a physician or another person designated by the board. Failure of a physician to submit to this examination when directed constitutes an admission of the allegations against the physician

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may issue a license limited to the practice of administrative medicine, or any other special license, as defined by routine technical rule of the board

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: for the purpose of permitting the physician to serve as locum tenens for another physician who is licensed to practice medicine in this State. The fee for this temporary license may not be more than $400.
